function: Excluded (system): learned sensing-packet timing for ISAC micro-Doppler reconstruction over one scalar CIR link, no antenna array or RIS; p. 2: "expressed as a sum of L Dirac delta components".
notes: Reason system (code 6). The learned method, a PPO agent with CNN policy and value networks, picks the transmission times of sensing packets in communication-centric ISAC to minimize the micro-Doppler reconstruction error (p. 1, p. 3). This fits area 5 (time resources that serve sensing in a system that communicates), so codes 1-5 do not apply: research letter (p. 1), learned component, sensing-matrix sampling design rather than user scheduling, and not sensing alone, since communication packets are part of the pattern (p. 2). The link is single-antenna with no RIS: the system model is one scalar CIR per window, p. 2: "The CIR h(τ, wTc) associated with the window depends on the propagation delay τ and time wTc, and is expressed as a sum of L Dirac delta components", with no antenna index; the hardware appears only as p. 4: "a monostatic ISAC platform operating at 60 GHz carrier frequency". No antenna, array, beam, MIMO, or RIS is mentioned anywhere in the paper. Reviewer to confirm: if the 60 GHz IEEE 802.11ay platform of the DISC dataset is read as a multi-antenna (phased-array) link, the work would be included as area 5; it trains and tests on the public measured DISC dataset with a DOI (p. 4, p. 5) and reports complexity and runtime (p. 5, Table I). Title and DOI on p. 1 match the record.
